deployments_detail.use: Intelligent document/knowledge search for R&D and scientists built under the Pfizer-Amazon Collaboration Team (PACT): voice- and chatbot-based search over research documents using Amazon Kendra plus generative AI (Anthropic Claude 2.1 via Amazon Bedrock). Moved into production. [AWS (Amazon Kendra, Amazon Bedrock), Anthropic Claude 2.1]
deployments_detail.value: Up to 16,000 hours of search time saved annually; 55% reduction in infrastructure costs; 5 of 14 PACT ideas moved to production

deployments_detail.use: AI-driven small-molecule drug discovery collaboration with XtalPi: deployment of XtalPi's XFEP (free-energy perturbation) platform to predict binding affinity and screen/design compounds; expansion of a long-running partnership whose crystal-structure-prediction AI supported Paxlovid development. [XtalPi (XFEP platform)]

AI applied to clinical trial optimization — machine-learning models for patient enrollment forecasting and site performance, developed with IBM (following the earlier IBM Watson for Drug Discovery immuno-oncology collaboration). [IBM (Watson)]

VOX — Pfizer's proprietary enterprise generative AI platform that lets employees securely work with large language models for innovation and productivity, built on AWS. [AWS (Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker)]

AI-driven pharmaceutical manufacturing: real-time anomaly detection on production lines, 'golden batch' optimal-parameter identification, and corrective-action recommendations to operators; includes an mRNA prediction algorithm for vaccine batches. [AWS (Amazon SageMaker, Amazon Lookout for Equipment/Metrics)]
deployments_detail.value: CEO Albert Bourla: AI-powered manufacturing increasing throughput by 20%; targets of 10% yield boost and 25% cycle-time reduction; ~20,000 additional vaccine doses per batch
